tasks.label: Build installer
tasks.detail: Builds dist/FreeCAD-MCP-Setup-<version>.exe and dist/freecad-mcp-<version>.mcpb (needs uv and Inno Setup 6).

tasks.label: Create GitHub release
tasks.detail: Picks the version (a new patch version if the tag is taken), builds the installer and creates the release with the .exe and .mcpb attached, from the branch you are on. Needs the gh CLI and a committed, pushed HEAD.

inputs.description: How should the GitHub release be created?

options.label: auto: current version, or the next patch version if its tag is taken
current: this version only (fails if it was already released)
patch: bump to the next patch version, commit and push
minor: bump to the next minor version, commit and push
major: bump to the next major version, commit and push
replace: delete the existing release and tag of this version, then recreate
